svg.title: Flutter agent pipeline: first prompt to simulator to App Store / Google Play / Web
svg.desc: End-to-end flowchart showing how 21 Claude Code agents, their MCPs, and external tools process a user prompt through strategy, design, architecture, implementation, quality gates, the Flutter simulator, and finally App Store / Google Play / Web (Vercel) submission.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about how the user prompt kicks off the agent pipeline')
g.text: "Build me a feature / fix this bug"

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does system-analyst do in the agent pipeline?')
g.text: Read AI · Google Drive · Gmail · Zoom · Calendar MCPs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens in the CI/CD gate before simulator testing?')
g.text: Build · lint · unit tests · coverage check

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does iOS Simulator fit into the Flutter pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does Android Emulator fit into the Flutter pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What happens during the Flutter release build stage?')
g.text: Code signing · IPA / AAB / build/web artefacts · version bump

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What MCPs and tools are needed for Apple App Store submission?')
sendPrompt('How is the Someday web build deployed to Vercel?')
sendPrompt('What MCPs and tools are needed for Google Play Store submission?')
sendPrompt('What monitoring happens after the app goes live?')

svg.text: What you still need to connect (mobile stores — web is already live)
Apple App Store Connect MCP — metadata, screenshots, phased rollout
Apple Dev Program — certificates, provisioning profiles, TestFlight
Fastlane match MCP — automated cert/profile sync (optional but recommended)
Google Play Developer API MCP — track management, AAB upload, review
Google Play Console — signing key, service account, internal testing
Firebase App Distribution MCP — pre-release tester builds (optional)
Tap any node to learn more · Dashed arrow = feedback/fix loop
